an5.1:1.1: Namo Tassa Bhagavato Arahato Sammāsam- buddhassa. I. 1. Evam me sutaṃ.
an5.1:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an5.1:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an5.1:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ:-- 3.
an5.1:3.2: Saddhābalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalena, hiribalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalena, ottappabalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalena, viriyabalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalena, paññābalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalenā ti. Evaṃ
